improvements: Authenticated GET/HEAD acquisition now consumes complete bounded streams before the original owner recheck. Its thirty-two-MiB limit and twelve-second budget cover helper bootstrap, auth, headers and body, with cancellation and disposal of late responses.

Cancellation stays AbortError and produces no fabricated outage notice. Auth/token waits cannot later dispatch cancelled data requests. Oversize or broken bodies use the existing fixed 503 shape; HTTP denials preserve their complete bytes and status, and HEAD/bodyless responses preserve empty-body semantics.

Read-owned notices recover per method/feed. An older failure cannot replace newer successful state; a recovered feed does not hide another failure. Notices associated with the separate mutation path are preserved, including when a mutation error reused an existing read notice.

A missing shared reader loads once from the same site, fails within its budget and never triggers a data request if unavailable. Public request routing, authorization, private kinds, and the original mutation implementation remain byte-identical apart from the new read-only branch.

browser_acceptance.scope: Original portfolio page and final current authentication adapter, reader, binding and risk scripts. Invented in-memory auth and API responses only; external connections denied by CSP.
browser_acceptance.matching: Full native synthetic matching snapshot and risk remain coherent, including measured-zero BBB risk.
browser_acceptance.cancellation: Delayed original AAA requests were cancelled and then released after BBB completed. BBB remained and no outage notice was displayed.
browser_acceptance.failure: Synthetic HTTP 503 clears risk/holdings values and shows an unavailable notice.
browser_acceptance.recovery_bug_found: Before the notice repair, successful BBB recovery left the old outage banner visible. Screenshot stage442-stale-notice-before.png records the reproduced candidate behavior.
browser_acceptance.recovery: Final source clears the stale read notice after both feeds recover; Return activates recovery. Node regressions separately cover partial recovery, denial-type changes, old failures and mutation-notice overlap.

limitations: All 24 checked complete static assets match the exact commit-bound live build. Eight representative pages load the shared helper once before the inspector. Native source and the five-minute portfolio refresh cadence are unchanged; normal private publication remains unverified.
The thirty-two-MiB complete private read is intentionally retained until the owner recheck; it is not a zero-copy memory guarantee. Downstream four-MiB portfolio limits remain separate.

This adapter preserves response bytes; the caller must validate JSON and apply its own generation/current-owner display guard. The inspector and portfolio pages already have those guards. Mutation response handling remains unchanged and does not inherit the new read limits.
Normal private publication, actual owner sessions, provider data, account reconciliation and model skill remain unverified. All ten institutional acceptance workstreams remain open.
push_verification: All push workflows green; no native source files changed

static_acceptance.scope: Whole static HTML, existing scripts and generated source registries only. No execution or current/private/derived packet requests.
